questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic is coming from both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves right, then left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead is low. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles go first. Stop only if needed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm down, then swings it to their side, the group should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green downward arrow over a lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that you are approaching a railroad crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns that a winding road is ahead. Reduce your speed to navigate safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight down with palm facing back, the group should stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders in groups communicate with each other. This signal tells other riders to follow you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill grade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not pass under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (in this case, 13 feet 6 inches).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Three-sided signs tell you to slow down at an intersection and be ready to stop. Let other traffic and pedestrians pass first. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a roundabout is ahead. Enter slowly and let traffic already in the roundabout go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used for no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black text on yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign means the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop and yield the right-of-way at an intersection. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved only for people with valid disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals instead of mechanical turn signals. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and pointed upward, it signals an intention to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers that parking is not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that a bridge ahead is narrow. You may not have room to safely pass or meet a truck. Drive carefully and be ready to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means you can turn left on a green light, but you must yield to oncoming traffic. You may only turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that bicycles cross this area. Watch for bicycles and be prepared to slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has three or more curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through it means something is prohibited. This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to an intersection ahead. Slow down and be prepared to yield or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black symbols. They alert you about road conditions or hazards ahead.
